propositions: A new optional, isolated transcript-mining adapter extracts and deterministically classifies error signatures from Claude Code session JSONL transcripts without LLM calls.

The adapter routes matched error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, pip errors, git errors, etc.) to a normalized classification enum (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) using substring/regex rules.
All emitted classification records carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels to signal low confidence and segregate from authoritative metrics.
The adapter is imported only by the optional backfill script and is NOT imported by core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) to maintain portability of the core command.

Unit tests verify fixture transcripts with known error signatures are classified deterministically, clean transcripts yield no records, and the backfill script exercised end-to-end emits labeled records.
